Name: Sapling
Description: The face of a boy turned to wood. Launches from flower pads and skips over still water.
HowToEarn: Played the Hymn of Mending on the first morning, lifting the curse and leaving the face behind.

Name: Boulderkin
Description: Heavy as the mountain that mourned him. Rolls, pounds, and walks through heat unharmed.
HowToEarn: Played the Hymn of Mending for the mountain elder's ghost on the road to the pass.

Name: Tideborn
Description: A drowned musician's last performance. Swims the deep bay and throws finned blades.
HowToEarn: Played the Hymn of Mending for the guitarist washed up on the shore of the bay.

Name: Wrath
Description: Given by the children on the moon, if every other mask is offered first. Only a boss's arena will hold it.
HowToEarn: Given by the last child in the field on the moon, once every other mask has been handed over.

Name: CourierCap
Description: The postman's route, worn on the head. Letterboxes give up what they hold.
HowToEarn: Finished the postman's round for him on the final day, when he could not bring himself to run it.

Name: SleeplessMask
Description: Eyes that never close. The drowsy will talk all night and tell you everything.
HowToEarn: Bought back from the pawnbroker after the thief who took it was caught in the act at midnight.

Name: BlastMask
Description: Detonates on command at the cost of your own skin. Bombs for the penniless.
HowToEarn: Given by the old woman with the bomb bag after seeing off the thief who tried to take it.

Name: UnseenMask
Description: Sight slides off it. Guards, gatekeepers and shopkeepers look straight through you.
HowToEarn: Left by a merchant hiding from a soldier at the swamp gate; wearing it, nobody sees you at all.

Name: GraceMask
Description: Draws scattered spirits back toward their fountain.
HowToEarn: Returned by the fountain spirit once her scattered pieces were carried back to her.

Name: FoxwardenMask
Description: Wear it in tall grass and something old and clever asks you riddles.
HowToEarn: Recovered from a hole in the ground after the town's tallest tale turned out to be true.

Name: MarchMask
Description: Anything small enough will fall in behind you and keep step.
HowToEarn: Given by the bandleader who cannot get anyone to march behind him any more.

Name: HareHood
Description: Long ears, longer stride. The ground goes by faster and secrets sound louder.
HowToEarn: Traded from the man in the field who wanted a picture of a thing nobody believes in.

Name: ChorusMask
Description: The mountain frogs answer it. Find all five and they will sing for you.
HowToEarn: Left frozen in the ice on the mountain road, thawed out with the spring.

Name: KeenNoseMask
Description: Scent becomes colour. Mushrooms, trails and buried things stand out.
HowToEarn: Given by the witch after her mushrooms were fetched from the deepest part of the woods.

Name: RanchMask
Description: A little sister's face. The herd trusts it and so do the people who keep them.
HowToEarn: Given by the younger sister at the ranch after her herd survived the night.

Name: RingleaderMask
Description: The face of a brother who left. It stops a grown man mid-sentence.
HowToEarn: Given by the elder sister at the ranch, who has not seen her brother since the carnival was announced.

Name: LostSonMask
Description: Shown to the right people it unwinds the town's longest, saddest errand.
HowToEarn: Given by a woman waiting at an empty altar for a man who never arrived.

Name: BetrothalMask
Description: Two halves finally joined. Worn on the last night it moves people who cannot be moved.
HowToEarn: Forged from two halves on the last night, when both halves of the couple were finally in the same room.

Name: TruthMask
Description: Beasts speak plainly and the stones under the town remember out loud.
HowToEarn: Won back from the spider house at the edge of the swamp, one gold spider at a time.

Name: DancersMask
Description: Left by a ghost who only wanted his steps taught to someone.
HowToEarn: Left by a ghost on a stone in the fields who only wanted his steps remembered by someone.

Name: WrappedMask
Description: The bandaged dead take you for one of their own and ask for what they are owed.
HowToEarn: Taken from the bandaged thing at the bottom of the well, in exchange for what it was owed.

Name: SpectreMask
Description: Call the watchers of the ruined kingdom out of the air and make them answer.
HowToEarn: Won from the watcher who challenges anyone climbing the canyon road.

Name: CaptainsHelm
Description: The bone soldiers still take orders from whoever wears the crest.
HowToEarn: Taken from the bone captain in the barrow after he was played to sleep.

Name: TitanMask
Description: Found in the last temple's depths. Fills the arena and fights on the boss's own scale.
HowToEarn: Found in a sealed room in the last temple, sized for something far larger than a person.
